title: CapCut Releases New AI Capabilities: Professional Edition Launched, CapCut Hub Mobile App Introduces AI Assistant Xiaoying

content_html:
CapCut held the "AI New Creation Launch Event," introducing multiple AI new features such as CapCut Hub and the AI creation assistant "Xiaoying," and upgraded the creator ecosystem to build a comprehensive intelligent creation platform covering scenarios from beginners to professionals.

Pro Version: One-stop Workstation and Intelligent Creation Agent

CapCut Pro launched a one-stop creative workstation "CapCut Hub" and an intelligent creation agent "CapCut Assistant." It also upgraded professional functions, expanded device compatibility, and launched "AI Ultra Membership" at the same time.

The CapCut app introduced the mobile AI creation assistant "Xiaoying," which can serve various creative scenarios and can also act as an AI marketing expert.

Comprehensive Upgrade of the Creator Ecosystem

In terms of the ecosystem, CapCut upgraded the "Copy the Same" model, promoted the development of professional content and AI Skills, and upgraded creator services by launching an incentive program, "Template Author AI Assistant," beginner tasks, and the "CapCut Creator Partner" program to help creators at different stages complete their works smoothly.
